title: I Bought My Past for $100M, The ruthless CEO Lost His Mind
intro: Sylvia had been married into a wealthy family for ten years, yet she was betrayed by her husband Sebastian and Chloe, her half-sister. Her father and elder brother even abetted their scheme, deceiving her for three long years. Her heart completely broken, she signed the divorce papers and walked away with a hundred million.
